newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS-FX vol curve inverted despite weekend.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-FX vol curve inverted despite weekend.

text.p: Volatility curves for major dollar-pair options stayed inverted in U.S. trading despite weekend time-decay pressure, which usually depresses the front end, dealers said.

Traders said speculation that the dollar could break out any time now -- probably to the upside in dollar/mark and either direction in dollar/yen -- buoyed short-dated options, which have higher gamma and are sensitive to spot swings.
"There's still that feeling that there's something yet to happen," said Alan Revercomb, options strategist at I.D.E.A. Inc in New York.
